content:
The **Fragmentation Grenade** is a weapon in *Fallout 76*.

Fragmentation Grenades are generally simple and effective. They are widely used throughout Appalachia.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Adhesive (2) Aluminum (1) Fertilizer (2) Oil (2) Spring (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Known by default | | Fragmentation Grenade (1) | 

- One inside the Rusty Pick.
- Can be retrieved from grenade bouquets while having the Home Defense perk equipped.
- Can sometimes be found inside the Communist Collectron Stations when operated in "Revolutionary" mode.
- Can sometimes be found inside the BoS Collectron station.
- Commonly found on Super Mutants.
- Can be found on Scorched suiciders on the mezzanine level at the Top of the World and in Daily Ops.
